notes.title: 1.3.2 Update / Balance Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the upgrade algorithm from 1.3 update.
[*] Costs should now update properly when making x5, x20 or Max upgrade purchases.
[*] Initial upgrade costs now load based on new algorithm.
[*] Fixed PP going negative when using auto clicker at higher rates
[*] Multiple Vibe Shop instances opening with rapid clicks
[*] Autobuy properly taking up PP when making purchases now.
[*] Fixed the secret ending triggering even after an ending AI path was chosen.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Secret ending now has a defined path and not random anymore based on achievement feedback. It now has a repeatable, and more obvious unlock path once you figure it out. 
[*] More money added to later upgrades to help reduce the number of clicks needed to beat the game.
[*] Balance upgrade costs for better pacing throughout the upgrades.
[/list]

notes.title: Vibe Clicker - Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][p][b]Max Purchase Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added "Max" buying option for all upgrades - no more tedious clicking to level items from 150+ to thousands![/p][/*][*][p]Total cost display for Max Buy now shows in the upgrade info boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Smart resource calculation - Max buy automatically calculates the highest level you can afford[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enhanced Vibe Shop Experience[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Vibe Shop is available from the start. You can start collecting Vibe Points and customizing your clicker experience early![/p][/*][*][p]Added short description on the shop to explain what the clickers do[/p][/*][*][p]Vibe Shop persistence - items no longer clear from the shop after unlocking end-game AI options[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto-focus management - buttons like "Auto Buy" no longer steal focus from clicking when using the Spacebar.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended upgrade UI for better visibility and interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Resources are always visible after tutorial completion (they were hiding from you)[/p][/*][*][p]The clicker equipment system allows you to unequip clickers. The clicker will default to the career phase you’re currently at.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Major Fixes[/b][/h3][p][b]Performance & Timing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed 3-5 second delay between clicking and money appearing[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved sound delays during “rapid” clicking sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected purchase intervals - now properly applies x5 and Max button upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resource/upgrade purchase timing synchronization (no more waiting on the UI once you have enough money)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Save System & Progression[/b][/p][list][*][p]Save data reset functionality now works properly after Legend phase[/p][/*][*][p]Resources no longer disappear after selecting an End-game AI[/p][/*][*][p]Expert tier now unlocks correctly after Final Click without restarting the game[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio System[/b][/p][list][*][p]The purchase button sounds now play the correct audio for each transaction type[/p][/*][*][p]No sound when buttons are disabled for better feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Full upgrade sound reliability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Button interaction audio consistency fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the audio queuing system so you don’t miss out on UI interactions when clicking fast.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Auto-Buy System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto-buy logic overhaul -
